description: Converts scene breakdowns into detailed image generation prompts.

required_fields.title: Short unique file name/title
required_fields.main_subject: Core subject + action (start with subject, use active verbs)
required_fields.visual_style: Global art direction - MUST be consistent across all images
required_fields.details: List of specific visual elements (background, props, textures)
required_fields.negative_prompts: List of things to avoid (blur, distortion, watermark, etc.)

pro_tips: Use camera terminology: Low angle shot, Close-up, Wide establishing shot, Depth of field
Describe lighting explicitly: Rim lighting, Softbox lighting, Sunset golden hour
Keep visual_style identical for every prompt unless scene dictates flashback/dream
configurable_values.default_visual_style: Cinematic 3D Render, vibrant colors, soft global illumination, high fidelity, 8k resolution
configurable_values.output_format: JSON array of image prompt objects
